name: Journal figure requirements: size, resolution, format and font specifications by publisher
citation: SciDraw AI. (2026). Journal figure requirements: size, resolution, format and font specifications by publisher [Data set]. https://sci-draw.com/journal-figure-requirements

records.scope: Nature "Guide to preparing final artwork" PDFs. The two official PDFs disagree on exact widths — both values are shown.
records.photoDpi: 300 dpi minimum at final used size
records.combinationDpi: bitmap parts ≥ 300 dpi; vector parts kept as vector
records.formats: AI, Vector EPS, Layered PSD, PostScript, PDF, PowerPoint, Word, Excel, CorelDraw (≤ v8)
records.rejectedFormats: JPEG, TIFF, PNG, DeltaGraph, TeX, ChemDraw, Canvas, SigmaPlot
records.colorMode: RGB recommended (auto-converted to CMYK for print); CMYK optional
records.fonts: Sans-serif, preferably Helvetica or Arial (Courier for amino-acid sequences)
records.minFontSize: 5 pt minimum, 7 pt maximum for body text
records.panelLabels: Lowercase a, b, c — 8 pt bold, upright (not italic)
records.notes: Nature’s own two official artwork guides disagree: the general journals guide states 88/180 mm, the Nature-branded artwork guide states 89/183 mm. Both are current. | Nature requires vector line art and states "Do not rasterize line art or text" — there is no line-art DPI.

records.scope: Science "Instructions for preparing an initial manuscript", Preparation of figures. Color mode and line-art DPI live on the separate revised-manuscript page and are marked not-found here.
records.formats: Vector (Adobe Illustrator) preferred, Files must be readable by Photoshop or Illustrator
records.maxFileSize: Revision combined file ≤ 50 MB (no per-figure initial limit stated)
records.minFontSize: ~7 pt (2.5 mm), not smaller than 5 pt; symbols ≥ 6 pt
records.panelLabels: Capital A, B, C — 10 pt bold
records.notes: The widely repeated "5.5 cm / 12 cm" is incorrect. Official widths are 5.7 / 12.1 cm, plus a third 18.4 cm 3-column width. | Read via a 2025-08-10 Wayback snapshot because the live page blocks automated access; widths/DPI match the current live guidance.

records.scope: Cell Press "Digital image guidelines". Widths shown are for 2-column-format journals (Cell, Molecular Cell, Neuron, etc.); other Cell Press families use different widths (see notes).
records.maxHeight: Must fit a single 8.5 × 11 in page
records.formats: Initial: TIFF or PDF preferred (PDF < 3 MB); JPEG or EPS accepted, Final: high-res TIFF, PDF, or CDX
records.colorMode: RGB (red and green should not be used together)
records.maxFileSize: Initial PDF < 3 MB; final files ≤ 20 MB each
records.panelLabels: Capital letters (no pt size or weight specified)
records.notes: Other Cell Press families differ: 3-column journals use 55/114/174 mm; Joule, Matter, Chem, Med, CRPS use 112/172 mm; iScience & STAR Protocols use 134.6/172 mm. | Cell mandates Arial specifically (not "Helvetica or Arial") and defines the most granular DPI tiers of the three flagship journals. | Read via a 2023-12-30 Wayback snapshot because the live page blocks automated access; widths match current live guidance.

records.scope: PLOS ONE "Figures" guidelines. PLOS uses pixel-based min/max sizing and a single DPI range, not column tiers.
records.notes: PLOS does not define separate line-art / halftone / combination DPI — one 300–600 dpi range applies to all. | Figures are validated by PLOS’s automated NAAS tool (historically branded PACE).

records.scope: Wiley Author Services "Figure preparation" guidelines. Intentionally general — Wiley defers exact column widths, color mode and fonts to each journal’s own author guidelines.
records.singleColumn: 80–180 mm width range (no discrete column values)
records.photoDpi: 300 dpi (≥ 80 mm canvas or 1800 px wide)
records.formats: Vector: PDF, PS, EPS, Bitmap: PNG, TIFF, When in doubt, submit a PDF
records.maxFileSize: < 10 MB per figure (< 500 MB total package)
records.minFontSize: Not specified numerically ("large enough for easy reading")
records.notes: This Wiley page is deliberately general; several print specs (exact widths, color mode, fonts) live in each journal’s own author guidelines.

records.scope: Elsevier "Artwork and media instructions" (sizing, artwork types, formats, and general points/boilerplate).
records.lineArtDpi: 1000 dpi (1200 dpi for very fine lines)
records.formats: EPS (preferred for vector), PDF, TIFF, JPEG, Microsoft Office files
records.colorMode: RGB (converted to CMYK for the print process)
records.fonts: Arial (or Helvetica), Courier, Symbol, Times (or Times New Roman)
records.minFontSize: 7 pt for normal text; no smaller than 6 pt for subscript/superscript (at final printed size)
records.notes: Font size (7 pt / 6 pt) and RGB color mode are Elsevier’s standard artwork boilerplate, confirmed via elsevier.com; Elsevier’s landing pages render only partially to automated fetch.

records.scope: Standard Springer Nature artwork guidelines as published on a Springer journal submission-guidelines page. Individual journals may vary.
records.maxHeight: Not higher than 234 mm; length ≤ 23.4 cm
records.formats: Vector: EPS (preferred), Halftone: TIFF, MS Office files acceptable
records.fonts: Helvetica or Arial (sans serif); embed fonts in vector files
records.notes: Springer’s generic width sentence labels widths counterintuitively; the explicit size list (3.9 / 8.4 / 12.9 / 17.4 cm) is authoritative.

records.scope: IEEE Author Center graphics guidelines (resolution-and-size, file-formatting).
records.formats: PS, EPS, PDF, PNG, TIFF (vector preferred: PS, EPS, PDF)
records.fonts: Helvetica, Times New Roman, Arial, Cambria, Symbol
records.minFontSize: ~9–10 pt when viewed at full size

records.scope: RSC Chemical Science author guidelines. Values are Chemical Science’s and may differ for other RSC journals.
records.formats: TIFF (preferred, 600 dpi+), EPS or PDF acceptable (converted to TIFF)
records.notes: Graphical abstract / TOC entry: maximum 8 cm × 4 cm, 600 dpi TIFF, ≤ 250 characters. | RSC states only a general 600 dpi figure resolution; separate line-art/combination DPI are not given.

records.scope: JCI figure instructions (2021 figure kiosk). JCI sizes the complete figure rather than by column.
records.singleColumn: Complete figure 9–18 cm (3.5–7.1 in); no separate single/double
records.maxHeight: 17.25 cm (6.8 in) for complete figure with legend (¾ page)
records.formats: TIFF (preferred), PowerPoint, High-resolution PDF, EPS, Illustrator
records.panelLabels: Uppercase roman letters A, B, C
